1. Give each pixel the grid cell of its position, brightness and color, each divided by its sigma and rounded down.
2. Build S, which adds pixels into cells, and the blur B over neighboring cells.
3. Scale B by bistochastization, in 10 steps.
4. For each color channel, solve the sparse linear system with preconditioned conjugate gradients.
5. Give each pixel the value of its cell.
